verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a dedicated Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) feature that lets developers use their personal provider API keys through the gateway, which covers the core of the story. The MCP user-keys feature is a separate capability and is not credited here. The evidence is a single summary line from first-party docs, so the depth is thin. missing for 10: details on how keys are configured, which providers are supported, how BYOK traffic is routed and billed compared with Requesty-managed keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own provider API keys and have the gateway use them for my traffic

citations.quote: Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) allows you to use your personal API keys from various providers with Requesty.
